# Data

## synthetic_tensile.csv
**SIMULATED data, not experimental.** Generated by `src/generate_data.py`
from a known model (RA = RA0 * exp(-k * C_H) plus Gaussian noise, fixed
random seed) to validate the analysis pipeline. It does not represent real
test results.

## literature_data.csv
(K. Kiuchi and R. B. McLellan, “The solubility and diffusivity of hydrogen in well-annealed and deformed iron,” Acta Metallurgica, vol. 31, no. 7, pp. 961–984, Jul. 1983, doi: 10.1016/0001-6160(83)90192-X.) Values digitised from published papers. See SOURCES.md.
